testsuite.name: gg.rsmod.plugins.content.mechanics.deadman.SafeDepositBoxTests

testcase.name: GE exclusion alone does not prevent safekeeping but fully retired items are refused
untradeables and notes of untradeables cannot be stored
new skull invalidates an open session for deposits withdrawals and reads
registered container roundtrips in player JSON with attributes and stays outside usable items
notes count per unit and keep their form on withdrawal
loot key skull blocks access even without a skull timer
Wizard close then Seer reopen shares one box while accounts stay separate
ten coins occupy ten slots and a full box never consumes another unit
invalid packets and stale ids are noops
charges survive deposit and withdrawal without aliasing or creation redirects
PvM and PvP death resolution never includes stored items or makes them carried keeps
full inventory and max stack leave box untouched then allow exact stack merge
repeated roundtrips conserve quantity and never duplicate a stored item
